title: Y-axis scaling can lead to confusing views
symptom: The y-axis (BG value) is auto-scaled to the highest level within the last 24h, which can make steep slopes appear flatter than they are and give confusing impressions. A single bad point can make the graph useless for 24 hours.
cause: The y-axis scaling is based on the highest value in the last 24 hours, which can be skewed by a single high reading (even a bad one) and remains scaled for 24 hours.
fix: Navid200 is testing a candidate that pans the main screen instead of changing the axis min/max, so slopes never change. The main screen keeps tracking recent readings and auto-pans based on readings from the past 3 hours, but the y-axis range is user-controlled. Additionally, a PR was opened to avoid resizing the vertical axis for readings marked as bad.
evidence_quote: I finally have a candidate that I am testing. It pans instead of changing the axis min/max. Therefore, the slopes never change.
